Fraction mein neeche wala number roti ke kul barabar tukde ginta hai, upar wala number, jitne tukde humne liye. Ek tukda rangin hai, ek bina rang ka. Toh rangin tukde ke liye kaunsa fraction likhoge?

Haan, sahi hai. Chaaron tukde milkar poora cake hain; teen chhote barabar hain aur bada unse bada, toh har chhota tukda 1/4 se kam. Ab ek cheez ki jagah bahut saari cheezein lenge, jaise laddoo, aam ya kanche, aur unka fraction nikalenge. Niyam wahi rahega: sab barabar. Yahan tak saaf hai?
